notes.title: Update 119
notes.notes:
1. Now all beds fully restore energy and life after sleeping.
2. The penalty for losing has been reduced by half.
3. Fixed a bug with milking cows
4. Minor UI fixes

notes.title: Update 118
notes.notes:
1. New items and recipes have been added.
2. Changes in the resource balance in the mine, now new resources appear earlier.
3. The amount of resources for crafting armor has been reduced.
4. Now fewer hits with a pickaxe are needed to mine ore.
5. Changes in the coal search quest.
6. Fixed a bug with a hint appearing multiple times at Bulat’s house
7. The characteristics of some monsters have been changed

notes.title: Hotfix 117
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where a dismantled chest would turn into its base version - a wooden chest.

notes.title: Update 116
notes.notes:
1. You can now catch a blueprint of an item when fishing.
2. Added 18 new items
3. Large Rock and Medium Rock now give more stones.
4. Fixed an issue where the joystick would not work in some cases when the player opened the crafting menu.
5. Fixed a bug where 2 or more identical items in a chest could lead to corruption of the save file.
6. Fixed a bug due to which the player could create an item for free if the inventory was almost full.
7. Fixed a bug with fishing when the caught item disappeared due to a full inventory.
8. Minor changes to the message about the player sleeping on the ground.

notes.title: Update 115
notes.notes:
1. You can now turn candles and lamps on/off.
2. Added 6 new items.
3. Added 5 new hairstyles.
4. Fixed an issue that caused the player to get stuck sitting on something when bedtime started.
5. Fixed colliders of some items.

notes.title: Update 114
notes.notes:
1. 4 new crafting items have been added.
2. The amount of resources for crafting some items has been changed.
3. One more boss has its quest.
4. The number of energy and health recovery points for beds has been changed.
5. Fixed an empty line in one of the dialogs. Removed 2 unnecessary dialogue lines.

notes.title: Update 113
notes.notes:
1. Added a quest to one of the bosses.
2. Changes in the fishing process. Now energy is consumed only after catching a fish. After casting the fishing rod, no energy is consumed.

notes.title: Update 112
notes.notes:
1. Added an alternative way to interact with one of the bosses.
2. Fixed a bug with the player getting stuck in one of the dungeon locations.
3. Fixed a bug with the position of some icons when cooking food at a campfire.

notes.title: Update 111
notes.notes:
1. Added an alternative way to deal with the first boss.
2. Fixed a bug with fish getting stuck after fishing.

notes.title: Hotfix 109
notes.notes:
Happy Friday everyone!
- fixed rare bug with fishing animation
- now the float of the fishing rod cannot be above the boat on the sea beach
- added manual save button
- the first boss now deals less damage
- sleeping bag now restores more energy

notes.title: Forest Spirit – Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm glad to present my new game – FOREST SPIRIT! Today it is released into Early Access. This means that you can start building your dream farm right now!

Game Features:
- manage your farm
- fight many monsters and bosses
- explore different locations
- cut wood, mine ore and get many other resources
- make different items from a sleeping bag to a big house and expensive armor.
- get animals and take care of them
- grow vegetables and fruits.
- meet local residents who will help you get comfortable in a new place.
- improve your fishing skills.
- prepare various dishes.

I hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Forest Spirit EA Release Date Announcement – October 3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I am pleased to present to your attention my first game on Steam - Forest Spirit!

Tired of office life, you go to live in nature. You can start your journey on OCTOBER 3, 2023. Will you be able to settle into a new place and build the farm of your dreams?

Game Features:
- manage your farm
- fight many monsters and bosses
- explore different locations
- cut wood, mine ore and get many other resources
- make different items from a sleeping bag to a big house and expensive armor.
- get animals and take care of them
- grow vegetables and fruits.
- meet local residents who will help you get comfortable in a new place.
- improve your fishing skills.
- prepare various dishes.

Hope you enjoy the game! Add Forest Spirit to your wishlist to be notified the day the game releases.
